name: JNI Helper
description: Auto import JNI types for Android SO analysis. Set first parameter to JNIEnv* to recognize JNI calls.
longdescription:
# JNI Helper

A Binary Ninja plugin for Android native library analysis.

## Features

- Auto install JNI type library (arm32/arm64)
- Auto set JNI_OnLoad/JNI_OnUnload signatures
- Auto set Java_xxx function signatures
- Right-click any function to set as JNI function

## Usage

1. Open an Android SO file
2. Run `Plugins -> JNI Helper -> Setup JNI Types`
3. For obfuscated functions, right-click and select `Set as JNI Function`
4. Or press Y and manually set first param to `JNIEnv* env`

installinstructions.Darwin: Copy plugin folder to ~/Library/Application Support/Binary Ninja/plugins/
